annotations.title: One race on the user's list

description: One race the user has saved, in as much depth as asked for: the race itself, the training sessions between today and race day, and the diary notes linked to it. sections picks the parts (race, training, notes, plans, travel, weather); left out, it returns race, training and notes. Ask for the others by name: plans (what was saved with save_trip_plan; without it, saved_plans names the sections that exist), travel (nearest airports, drive, train) and weather (race day in the last five years, plus the forecast within 16 days). Anything they do not know is in unknown. For any race on the site rather than one on the user's list, call get_race. Requires signing in.

race_id.description: id of the race on the user's list, from get_calendar.

sections.description: Parts to return: race, training, notes, plans, travel, weather. Omit for race, training and notes.

title.description: The race name as the list shows it, when there is no id or slug.
